# Financial Forecasting Studio

> A local-first financial scenario modeller that evaluates daily cash feasibility separately from net present value.

Version: 1.0.0
Runtime: Python 3.11+ and a current browser
Runtime dependencies: Python standard library only
Data: local SQLite; private runtime data is excluded from version control

## Start here

- README.md: product overview, quick start, features, technology, privacy, and limitations
- docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md: problem, intended users, goals, non-goals, and success criteria
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: components, local API, data flow, trust boundaries, and change guide
- docs/FINANCIAL_DECISIONS.md: formulas, rounding, schedule conventions, and worked examples
- docs/VERIFICATION.md: automated and browser verification evidence
- docs/AI_CONTEXT.md: concise facts, terminology, constraints, and claim-to-evidence map
- SECURITY.md: local security model and sensitive-data guidance
- CONTRIBUTING.md: development and verification rules

## Source map

- studio/finance.py: deterministic validation and financial calculations
- studio/dates.py: calendar schedules and 30E/360 day counts
- studio/storage.py: SQLite documents, transactions, and revisions
- studio/server.py: local HTTP interface and static-file serving
- web/app.js: interface state, views, forms, and API integration
- web/chart.js: SVG chart rendering and interaction
- tests/: 87 automated tests

## Important invariants

- Monetary calculations remain in Python Decimal.
- Monetary JSON values remain strings.
- Opening cash affects liquidity but is excluded from NPV.
- The server remains loopback-only.
- Real scenario databases and exports are never committed.
